run.title: Write an I2C driver for BMP180 on STM32F303RE from scratch
run.taskPrompt:
Write an I2C driver for BMP180 on STM32F303RE from scratch.
- I2C1: SDA=PB9, SCL=PB8
- LA wiring: CH0=SDA, CH1=SCL
Goal: verify sensor is working.

plan.title: Inspect existing repo files
plan.detail: Read Makefile and main.c to understand the current build skeleton, linker script, and any existing stubs before writing new code.

plan.title: Write BMP180 firmware from scratch
plan.detail: Write main.c implementing: (1) RCC clock setup — keep 8 MHz HSI, enable GPIOB + I2C1 clocks; (2) GPIO PB8/PB9 as AF4 open-drain; (3) I2C1 init with TIMINGR = 0x00310309 for ~100 kHz at 8 MHz PCLK (standard-mode values from STM32F3 reference); (4) BMP180 chip-ID read (reg 0xD0, expect 0x55); (5) BMP180 calibration coefficient read (11 × 16-bit registers starting at 0xAA); (6) temperature + pressure one-shot measurement with oversampling=0; (7) RTT printf of chip_id, raw_temp, raw_pressure, computed temperature (0.1 °C units) and pressure (Pa). RTT is provided by the pre-built rtt-f303re.elf object; include SEGGER_RTT.h and link against it via Makefile. Also update the Makefile to compile main.c and link the RTT object.

plan.title: Build firmware
plan.detail: Run 'make clean && make' via build_firmware and confirm exit code 0 and ELF produced.

plan.title: Flash firmware to Nucleo-F303RE
plan.detail: Use pyocd flash --target stm32f303retx rtt-f303re.elf. Approval-gated by harness.

plan.title: Capture I2C bus traffic at startup and read RTT log
plan.detail: Use reset_and_capture_i2c (approval-gated reset + simultaneous LA capture) so the chip-ID transaction at startup is captured. Decode CH1=SCL / CH0=SDA at I2C 100 kHz. Separately read RTT log via read_firmware_log to collect chip_id, temperature, pressure output.

plan.title: Record all checks and diagnose any failures
plan.detail: Record check verdicts for: build exit code, chip-id over RTT, device ACK on I2C bus, SCL frequency in 90–110 kHz band, temperature plausible (10–50 °C), pressure plausible (80000–110000 Pa). If any check fails, call declare_diagnosis with ranked hypotheses and proposed fix, then declare_iteration.

plan.title: Write final evidence-linked report
plan.detail: Summarise objective, procedure, all recorded checks with artifact citations, root cause if any, and reproduction steps.

payload.riskSummary: Two hardware mutations occur in this run. (1) Flash: the Nucleo-F303RE is erased and re-programmed via pyocd; this is approval-gated by the harness and irreversible on the current firmware — the board profile confirms USB/ST-LINK power and a known-good 3V3 rail, and the flash command targets exactly stm32f303retx, so no wrong-device risk. (2) Reset: reset_and_capture_i2c issues a pyocd reset to synchronise the LA capture with firmware startup; this is a soft reset only (no erase) and is also approval-gated. No other hardware mutations are attempted. All GPIO and I2C register writes are confined to the firmware image being flashed.

- `CHIP_ID=0x55` ✅
- `CAL OK`
